units.title: Identity federation and intake adapter
units.acceptanceCriteria: Verify normal behavior and rejection paths with source-bound automated evidence. Live acceptance is separate.
units.implementationStatus: Partial: merged PR2 supplies pinned managed intake service verification with explicit local non-owner identity mapping; it does not authenticate end users. PR3 snapshots trusted mappings and bounds credential/transport/body verification with cancellation, finite byte/chunk budgets, strict JSON UTF8 and sanitized failures. End-user federation, member provisioning and live host integration remain pending.

units.title: Persistent authorization administration and audit
units.acceptanceCriteria: Verify normal behavior and rejection paths with source-bound automated evidence. Live acceptance is separate.
units.implementationStatus: Partial PR4: Identity-owned durable monotonic policy/actor epochs and exact capability revocations, fixed trusted human administrator admission before cached lookup, immutable revision/idempotent audit/outbox commands and current-state capability verification under project serialization. Dynamic membership, federation, qualified host/key services, independent network contention and live acceptance remain pending. Final-head CI is separate from local test evidence. Partial PR5 adds disposable PostgreSQL17 restricted TCP-session tests for revision contention, directly observed verification lock waits followed by revocation/expiry, lost post-COMMIT acknowledgement/fresh pool and role/scope boundaries. Local ordinary/typecheck/build/registry pass; actual CI execution/final-head acceptance are separate. No production host/key/TLS/failover/throughput or live qualification. All five PostgreSQL17 network groups passed CI40573050463 on c25f03f472da86fc0a9f8f84395e68faf8f53b2d, with job122432072794 logs inspected. Final-head CI remains required; this is no production identity/deployment qualification. WIP: bounded dynamic membership module with stored human-owner admission, last-owner protection and per-principal current-role resolution; first four restricted migration groups/typecheck pass. Further review/adversarial/package/current-head CI pending. No authenticated host or atomic membership/capability/external-action integration.
